builds.name: Reference: Third-hit duelist control
builds.goal: Win sustained trades with real W and R hits
builds.summary: Win sustained trades with real W and R hits.
builds.hypothesis: Passive attack-speed stacks and the R attack counter make the starting state matter. W on an attack and W consumed through Q are different sequences. The bruiser control preserves contact long enough to realize them; R resists require an actual champion hit.
testPlan: Compare zero and eight earned passive stacks, record the R counter, and test W-attack versus W-Q. Count landed attacks, shields/heals and R champions hit.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: A fully pre-stacked dummy trial hides lost contact; R misses and supplies none of the assumed defenses.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
Farmed-role experiments require actual income and a viable early lane/clear. A support comparison keeps quest/vision responsibility.
Item/rune/pet/empowered-attack proc compatibility must be observed rather than inferred from a shared damage type.
buyOrder: Trinity attack checkpoint, then Sundered Sky or matchup protection; Shojin only when extra casts are actually landed.
Compare a two-item checkpoint before the late six-slot illustration. Preserve movement boots unless a measured late replacement improves delivered damage.
coverageNotes: No numerical adapter exists for this champion. These individually authored hypotheses need manual game measurements; no global damage optimum or historical novelty is claimed.
Stored patch 26.20 source formulas are evidence, not a certified executable simulation. Resolve ambiguous tokens/stat formulas and current proc interactions before assigning numerical damage.

builds.name: Damage interaction: AP Counter Strike ambush
builds.goal: Convert dodged attacks into an AP E burst
builds.summary: Convert dodged attacks into an AP E burst.
builds.hypothesis: E has AP and target-max-health magic damage, with amplification from actual dodged attacks up to its cap. W and R also have AP ratios; Dusk/Nashor support the follow-up. Q remains physical with bonus-AD scaling, so AP does not turn every part of the combo into magic.
testPlan: Compare zero dodges against five observed dodges at fixed HP/MR. Log E, W, R and item packets separately. Test W on Q versus W on a follow-up attack; only the actual attack can be credited with attack-based procs.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: The enemy refuses to attack into E, leaves the detonation, or bursts Jax through his thin defenses.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: R-resistance side-lane wall
builds.goal: Buy another duel cycle through R defenses
builds.summary: Buy another duel cycle through R defenses.
builds.hypothesis: R's champion-hit defenses include bonus-AD scaling, while Counter Strike denies attacks. Frozen Heart targets physical attack pressure; Hullbreaker requires an actual side lane and fifth-attack state. Survival is valuable only if it permits more W/E attacks, not because each defense is permanently active.
testPlan: Compare R hitting one champion versus missing; test a physical duelist then magic burst. Fix Hullbreaker attack count and passive stacks, and record whether another E/W cycle lands.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

failureConditions: R cannot connect, the opponent's damage profile defeats the defense choice, or side-lane commitment loses the larger objective.

builds.name: Experiment: Navori second-hit R loop
builds.goal: Use attack cadence to repeat W/E during R
builds.summary: Use attack cadence to repeat W/E during R.
builds.hypothesis: While the R active buff is running, its empowered attack cadence changes from every third to every second attack. Passive attack speed and Navori's remaining-cooldown reduction may create extra W/E opportunities. Navori is bought for cooldown interaction, not because Q/E become crit spells.
testPlan: Compare ten seconds with R active versus passive-only; record R attack-counter hits and real W/E intervals. Swap Navori for matched-cost haste and test moving targets.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

failureConditions: Few attacks land, R uptime is short, or the offensive slot loses the survival needed for a second E.
